clips.title: The story
paras: Laurna Morninglight is a night elf priest trainer residing in the tranquil settlement of Dolanaar within Teldrassil. Devoted to the Sisterhood of Elune, she guides budding acolytes emerging from Shadowglen in the spiritual rites and healing graces of the Moon Goddess. Her teachings prepare young night elf priests for the growing threats encroaching on the boughs of the World Tree.

Situated amidst the boughs of Dolanaar, Laurna Morninglight serves as one of the primary mentors for young priests who have completed their initial rites in Shadowglen. As new initiates step out into the broader reaches of Teldrassil, she instructs them on expanding their communion with Elune, balancing the light of healing with defensive rites necessary to survive an increasingly hostile wild.
